daily.today_energy: Your vibe is magnetic today, Gemini. The universe is giving you permission to be a little chaotic—lean into it. Trust your instincts over overthinking. Something small you've been mulling over is about to click into place.
daily.love: Whether you're coupled or single, authenticity is your superpower rn. Stop performing and just... exist. Someone's noticing the real you, and that's way more powerful than any perfectly curated version could ever be.
daily.career: Your ideas are hitting different today. If you've been sitting on a pitch or proposal, the energy supports you sharing it. You're not just thinking—you're channeling something genuinely useful. Let it flow.
daily.health: Your body's asking you to move in ways that feel good, not obligatory. Dance, walk, stretch—whatever lights you up. Hydration matters more than you think today. Listen to what your energy needs.

weekly.overview: Mercury's doing its thing this week, Gemini. You're entering a phase where your communication skills are basically superpowers. Lean into conversations that matter and trust your intuition when something feels off.
weekly.love: Your vibe is magnetic rn. Whether you're coupled up or single, this is prime time for meaningful connections. Don't overthink the small stuff—let authenticity be your love language and watch how people respond.
weekly.career: Ideas are flowing and your energy is infectious. This week favors collaboration and speaking up about what you've been sitting on. Your confidence is at an all-time high, so channel it into that project or proposal you've been hesitant about.
weekly.health: Your nervous system could use some grounding this week. Lean into movement that feels good—dancing, walking, yoga, whatever vibes with you. Rest isn't lazy; it's strategic. Your body's asking for balance, so listen.
